items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: I swear, I could sit down all night and listen at him play violin.

ctx.x: You told me the other day about hearing a violin player named John Gould. John Gould, yeah.

That's a nigga. Could you tell us a little bit about your son? I told you that and I meant that. And that nigga, I swear, I could sit down all night and listen at him play violin. Really good, isn't it?
